data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (timeanddate lookup, weather.com 10-day forecast, then mail draft with the same To, Subject and Body template) and names the right parameters (city, relative, day). It is weaker on three points: it hardcodes "Lille", it says "Send (or discard)" where the true workflow says never send and click Discard, and the body's forecast detail is more specific than the true one. Parameter names also vary ({relative_name} and {call_day} against {relative} and {day}). An automation could still be built from it with minor fixes.
